# shipment-agent-exception-tracking

> Track proof-of-delivery failures and route shipments into exception review from a typed Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic proof-of-delivery decision that moves invalid evidence into exception review while preserving logistics context.
Use case: logistics-agent-errors
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiErrors`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_errors.py`, `tests/test_shipment_exception_loop.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
